verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a first-party Vast Serverless product for running compute-intensive workloads without managing GPUs, billed for execution rather than GPU rental time. Its docs describe benchmark-driven automatic scaling that recruits GPUs for your workload, and endpoints can be deployed through the CLI, the Python SDK and a serverless client. missing for 10: explicit documentation of scale-to-zero behavior (only implied by pay-per-execution billing), details on autoscaling configuration and the code/worker deployment workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of serverless usage.
